subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed-service handoffs, or should it remain limited to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally separate background auto-update from explicit `update.run`, while the issue asks to change that operator contract for headless launchd deployments.

options.title: Keep current scope and clarify docs
options.body: Leave `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` as a background-auto-update kill-switch and document the supported way to avoid or disable explicit `update.run` restarts.

options.title: Extend the env kill-switch to update.run
options.body: Make control-plane `update.run` return a no-op or safe-command response when the env var is set, with launchd/global-install regression tests.

options.title: Add a separate control-plane kill-switch
options.body: Introduce a distinct operator-controlled setting for explicit update restarts so background auto-update and admin-triggered update semantics do not share one env var.

recommendation.title: Keep current scope and clarify docs
recommendation.body: Leave `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` as a background-auto-update kill-switch and document the supported way to avoid or disable explicit `update.run` restarts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current kill-switch behavior and much of the current updater code path are attributed to vincentkoc in the inspected history.
